name: browse
description: Opens a page in a remote Browser Use Cloud browser, optionally performs actions on it, and returns the page text, its HTML, or a screenshot. Use this for pages that need JavaScript or user interaction; prefer a simpler fetch tool for static pages.

url.description: The URL of the page to open.

actions.description: Optional actions to perform after the page loads, in order. Each item is an object with an 'action' key: {'action': 'click', 'selector': '...'}, {'action': 'fill', 'selector': '...', 'value': '...'}, {'action': 'press', 'selector': '...', 'key': '...'}, {'action': 'wait_for', 'selector': '...'}, or {'action': 'evaluate', 'expression': '...'}. Selectors use Playwright syntax. The evaluate expression is JavaScript evaluated in the page.

output.description: What to return: 'text' for the page's visible text (the default), 'html' for the full HTML written to a file, or 'screenshot' for a full-page PNG written to a file.
